REGOLITH — Linux
================

A retro isometric alien-colony builder. Prospect for hidden subsurface
deposits, mine them, and build toward launching the xenite beacon.


HOW TO RUN IT
-------------

  unzip Regolith-linux.zip
  chmod +x Regolith.x86_64
  ./Regolith.x86_64

x86_64 only. The binary is self-contained — no dependencies beyond the
usual desktop OpenGL stack.


CONTROLS
--------

  Left mouse    place a building / inspect one
  Right mouse   demolish (refunds half the cost) / cancel placement
  WASD          pan the camera
  Z             zoom
  P             prospecting overlay        O  building status overlay
  M             overhead map               F1 debug coordinates
  Space         pause          1 / 3       game speed
  Esc           menu (save, sound on/off, quit)


WHERE SAVES LIVE
----------------

  ~/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/Regolith/

The game autosaves every few minutes, and Esc -> Save Game makes a manual
save. Deleting that folder resets everything.
